description: This file defines the MethodStubber class, a subclass of ASM's MethodVisitor, which generates stub implementations of methods by overriding visitCode to throw a RuntimeException. It is part of a toolset for generating stub methods in Android projects.

classes.name: MethodStubber
classes.description: A custom ASM MethodVisitor implementation that replaces method bodies with a stub that throws RuntimeException.

methods.name: MethodStubber
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the stubber with method information.

methods.name: visitCode
methods.description: Overrides the visitCode to generate bytecode that throws a RuntimeException with message 'stub'.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Delegates to superclass to handle annotation visitation.

methods.name: visitAnnotationDefault
methods.description: Delegates to superclass for default annotation visitation.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Delegates to superclass to handle additional attributes.

methods.name: visitParameterAnnotation
methods.description: Delegates to superclass for parameter annotation visitation.
